# StoryOps Incident Report

- This record captures facts and decisions; it is not medical, legal,
  environmental, insurance, or regulatory advice.
- Protect people and contact appropriate emergency responders before completing
  the report.
- Keep medical, personnel, financial, legal, and customer details in
  access-restricted attachments. Do not paste secrets or unnecessary sensitive
  data into AI prompts.

unsupported quantity, or assign blame. Attach original evidence rather than
rewriting it.
